t0020-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0020-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0020-02.gloss: A lesson moves indoors while a roadside field test continues.
t0020-02.rival_reading: A response crew could have tested roadside treatment after a closure; closed lessons and a prepaid week do not show what the spray was meant to control.
